Pad Templates:
  SRC template: 'src'
    Availability: Always
    Capabilities:
      video/x-raw
      image/jpeg
      video/x-bayer
    Type: GstLibcameraPad
    Pad Properties:
      stream-role         : The selected stream role
                            flags: readable, writable, changeable only in NULL or READY state
                            Enum "GstLibcameraStreamRole" Default: 2, "video-recording"
                               (0): raw              - libcamera::Raw
                               (1): still-capture    - libcamera::StillCapture
                               (2): video-recording  - libcamera::VideoRecording
                               (3): view-finder      - libcamera::Viewfinder

Element Properties:
  buffer-count        : Requested application capture queue depth; zero uses the camera default, and unsupported values may be adjusted by the camera.
                        flags: readable, writable, changeable only in NULL or READY state
                        Unsigned Integer. Range: 0 - 4294967295 Default: 0 
  camera-name         : Select by name which camera to use.
                        flags: readable, writable, changeable only in NULL or READY state
                        String. Default: null
  external-buffer-mode: Control direct capture into compatible downstream DMA-BUF pools.
                        flags: readable, writable, changeable only in NULL or READY state
                        Enum "GstLibcameraExternalBufferMode" Default: 1, "preferred"
                           (0): disabled         - Disabled
                           (1): preferred        - Preferred
                           (2): required         - Required
  name                : The name of the object
                        flags: readable, writable
                        String. Default: "libcamerasrc0"
